name: Saijou Claudine
original_name: 西條 クロディーヌ
source:
"I must express my resentment, and my gratitude."

She is a former child actress who has starred in numerous stage plays and movies from a young age. A pure-hearted and highly experienced Stage Girl who knows the ropes of a stage play. Although she honed her skills against [url=/c133939]Maya[/url] as her greatest rival, she returned to her roots in France after graduation and is slated to join a revue in Paris.

[From [url=https://revuestarlight.bushiroadgames.com/en/character/claudine/]official website[/url]]
